_comment: Defines what the daily GitHub Actions watcher fetches and alerts on. The PWA trip profile (in localStorage) drives what the app SHOWS; this file drives what actually gets fetched and what the server-side push/email alerts use. To watch a different route/window, edit this file and commit it — the next daily run picks it up. Keep origins × destinations to a handful (each pair is one API call per month).

alerts._comment: Server-side alerts (push + email) sent by the daily workflow when the cheapest in-window estimated total is at or below targetPrice. Leave targetPrice null to disable all alerts. windowStartDate/windowEndDate optionally narrow which departure days count (empty = whole months).
